title: Carrot

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Carrots are crops grown from Carrot seeds. They can be eaten raw, but are more useful in Cauldron recipes.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
• Carrots are grown by planting Carrot seeds with the Cultivator.
• It takes between 1h 6m 40s and 1h 23m 20s (about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for them to fully grow.

Introduction. Carrots are crops grown from Carrot seeds. They can be eaten raw, but are more useful in Cauldron recipes.

Availability. • Carrots are grown by planting Carrot seeds with the Cultivator.
• It takes between 1h 6m 40s and 1h 23m 20s (about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for them to fully grow.
